messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Moi Erkki, I'm at site OULU-11 working on TRN-087. I just replaced the SFP, and the link is up now with good RX power, but traffic counters are staying at zero.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: By the way TRN-034 had a dispatch last week too, different thing though. But yeah, this TRN-087 is acting weird now.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Moi Veikko! Let me check the node from here. Yes, I see the link state is up and optical levels look totally normal.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: This is a known quirk with these units. When the link is up and optics are normal after an SFP change but counters stay at zero, you should just disable the interface, wait a bit, and then enable it again. Don't reboot the unit and don't swap the SFP again.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Ah okay, good to know. I was just about to swap the SFP again to be sure, glad I asked first. Let me try disabling the port now.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Okay, port is disabled. Waitng for a moment...

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Now enabled it back. Hey, the traffic counters started incrementing immediately! :)

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Excellent, traffic is flowing normally now. That bounce always clears the stuck buffer on TRN-087 after a hot-swap. Good job!
